mist-ocean.prompt: Cinematic film still, shot on 65mm: a lone figure in a long dark coat stands on a black sand shore at blue hour before a vast ocean of slow-rolling luminous mist. Far above, an infinite serene expanse of soft golden-white light breaks through a slate sky. A single narrow shaft of light descends to the misty horizon. Muted teal and gold grade, volumetric haze, photorealistic, contemplative, immense negative space.

gate-hall.prompt: Cinematic film still, shot on 65mm: a colossal torchlit stone hall, seven successive monumental gates receding into darkness, each gate taller than the last, carved with glowing cuneiform and hieroglyphs. A small figure in a dark coat walks the polished obsidian floor toward the first gate, reflections of torch flames rippling beneath their feet. Warm firelight against deep indigo shadow, embers drifting in the air, photorealistic, monumental scale.

storm-sea.prompt: Cinematic film still, shot on 65mm: a mountainous night ocean under an apocalyptic electrical storm, colossal waves lit from inside by branching lightning. In the sky a vast rotating cell of storm cloud glows from within, and inside its eye a giant humanoid silhouette of light stands wreathed in lightning. Below, a tiny figure in a dark coat stands calm on a spur of black rock as spray explodes around them. Torrential rain, god-rays through black cloud, muted realistic grade, photorealistic VFX blockbuster quality.

world-tree.prompt: Cinematic film still, shot on 65mm: an immense ancient tree rising out of a mist-filled valley at night, trunk wide as a tower, under cold starlight and a rippling green aurora. Ember-red glyphs glow faintly in a hollow beneath its roots, and sparks of light drift upward along the trunk like slow fireflies. A small figure in a dark coat stands among the roots looking up. Frost, moonlit bark, deep blues and greens with ember accents, photorealistic, sombre and holy.

crystal-dawn.prompt: Cinematic film still, shot on 65mm: dawn breaking over an endless plain of translucent crystal spires that refract the sunrise into prismatic beams, a calm golden sun rising through rose and amber sky. The figure in the dark coat walks away from camera down a shining avenue between the spires toward the sun, their long shadow cast behind them. Lens flare, prismatic light scatter, warm hopeful grade, photorealistic, vast and serene.
